content.text:
Here are good online options for ordering a birthday cake in the U.S.:

- **Goldbelly** — Best if you want cakes from well-known bakeries shipped nationwide; lots of styles including gluten-free, kosher, nut-free, and specialty cakes. ([goldbelly.com](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/best-birthday-cakes?irgwc=1&utm_source=openai))
- **Milk Bar** — Great for a fun, recognizable birthday cake; their signature Birthday Cake ships nationwide, and they recommend choosing a delivery date at least **2–3 days ahead**. ([milkbarstore.com](https://milkbarstore.com/products/birthday-cake?utm_source=openai))
- **Bake Me A Wish!** — A dedicated online cake-delivery service with nationwide shipping and birthday cake options. ([bakemeawish.com](https://www.bakemeawish.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **Carlo’s Bakery** — Offers nationwide delivery and local pickup, including online custom cake options. ([carlosbakery.com](https://carlosbakery.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **Local bakery via DoorDash/Uber Eats/Instacart** — Best for same-day or next-day delivery, especially if you want a fresh local cake.
- **Grocery stores** like Whole Foods, Safeway, Kroger, Publix, Costco, or Walmart — Often cheaper and good for custom message cakes; availability depends on your ZIP code.

If you tell me your **city/ZIP code**, **date needed**, and whether you want delivery or pickup, I can narrow it down to the best options near you.
